flags.observation: Contrast "fake twenty" vs "Vanderlip got a train ride" only lands if you know about the fake names; normies get no payoff.
Intro never tells the listener what we are doing here: no onboarding beat between thesis and joke.
"illusion burn" is a broken cut of "watch the illusion burn"; first card line ends ungrammatically.
Tip 5 missing: no artworkPrompt picture (octopus, lion banker, hamster) appears in any opener; bridges stay abstract labels.
"monetary complexity chosen the fraud" carries no sayable meaning as a spoken clause.
"science paralyzes in confusion" recites power "Paralyze one opponent with confusion" as a new claim with a new subject.
Card says "a private bank wearing a state mask"; dropping "state" loses the private-posing-as-public point.
Without "U.S.", "first private bank" contradicts beat 7, where the Bank of England came earlier.
Card wish "let the elite own it" becomes claim "the elite own it"; "central bank, and history agrees" is a fragment.
"Ghost.", "Monopoly.", "Market.", "Duck hunt.", "Confession.", "Christmas.", "Interest." just echo the next card name; no therefore/but link to the previous card.
Same one-word card-echo opener family recurs every third beat (10, 13, 16, 19, 22, 25, 28), far under ten lines apart.
"Hamilton's Ghost: Thomas Jefferson's Warning" makes the Jefferson quote sound spoken by Hamilton's ghost; attribution blurs.
Card punch "he was the market" is cut; "wasn't just playing the market" sets up with no payoff.
Card "The public has to believe this was their idea" becomes "the banking cartel was their idea", inverting whose idea.
Card asks "What if private bankers wrote public banking law?"; line asserts "bankers wrote public law in secret" as fact.
"central banking. Trust me, saving you is Reform." dangling fragment plus grafted power word; not one sayable thought.
114 characters with stacked colons "After Jekyll Island: Woodrow Wilson's Pen:"; exceeds one breath.
"Christmas" three times in one line; the opener repeats what the card name already says.
"Grigsged" is an unsingable German word; dropping "Book Money" leaves the listener nothing to understand.
Card "Inflation is a hidden tax created by expanding the money supply"; line makes the tax do the expanding; "Price stability?" loses its irony.
Outro punch is concrete but carries no expert dog whistle; it mostly restates card 28.
